title: Vectors for SPEC 7.3 rule 6: does a quote that covers /analyte name the analyte?
note: Each vector is run through the evidence check of a property `composition.regulated_basis_content` whose `analyte.code` is `code` and whose only evidence entry has `quote` and supports `/analyte`. `expect` true: the quote names the analyte (no rule-6 error); false: it does not. The symbol is matched case-sensitively on the NFKC-normalised quote, an alias on the normalised (lower-case) quote; in both cases no letter or digit may stand directly before or after the match.

vectors.why: symbol only; no alias in the quote
symbol between brackets; no alias in the quote
alias only; the symbol Zn is not in the quote
alias; a hyphen is a word boundary
alias in capitals, matched after case folding
alias; the symbol F is followed by a letter and does not count
Ag inside AgCl is followed by a letter; no alias
ion notation: Zn is followed by a digit, so the symbol does not match; only an alias would
